bruteforce.signature: rule_validation.py: TCP 22/23 between testbed hosts; attackers = client side (80 % cover, <= 10), victims = server side

web.signature: rule_validation.py: TCP 80/8080 between testbed hosts; attackers = client side, victims = server side (SQLi, XSS, Uploading, DoS and DDoS HTTP Flood)

dns.signature: rule_validation.py: rogue DNS responders (testbed hosts other than the gateway answering >= 5 UDP/53 flows)

arp.signature: rule_validation.py: ARP pseudo-flows 8.6.0.1<->8.0.6.4 plus all flows of the spoofing host (largest ICMP fan-out to testbed hosts)

syn.signature: TCP, SYN Flag Count >= 1 and >= 0.5 x hi, no payload in either direction, ACK Flag Count <= lo (hi/lo = larger/smaller of forward and backward packets); to a victim (sender = side with more packets)

udp.signature: UDP, lo = 0, hi >= 10 packets, and >= 100 packets/s per flow or >= 100 such flows to the same receiving host:port starting within one second; to a victim

ackfrag.signature: (TCP, ACK >= 1, SYN = 0, payload > 0, lo <= 1 or 2 lo <= hi) or (protocol 0, not the ARP pseudo-flow, hi >= 10, lo <= hi/10); to a victim

proto0flood.signature: protocol 0 (ICMP, GRE, fragments), not the ARP pseudo-flow, >= 1000 packets; to a victim

mirai_scan.signature: TCP to port 23/2323 from a testbed host (not the gateway) with >= 20 distinct destination addresses on these ports

recon.signature: TCP/UDP flows from a testbed host (not the gateway) with >= 50 distinct destination ports or >= 30 distinct testbed destination hosts (scanner) to testbed hosts
